label: Excellent
corporate_parent: Noritz Corporation — publicly traded (TSE: 5943), headquartered in Kobe, Japan
manufacturing_location: Engineering: Kobe, Japan. US assembly/distribution from US facilities

heat_exchanger.description: Dual stainless steel heat exchangers in condensing configuration. Same material approach as Navien. 25yr warranty signals manufacturer confidence in HX longevity.

burner_system.description: Premix burner with 12,800–199,900 BTU modulation range. Engineered for low NOx.

construction.body: Wall-mounted, ~60 lbs, 26.1" x 18.1" x 11.8". Top-mount water connections for easy tank-to-tankless retrofit.
construction.retrofit_design: Top-mount connections align with existing tank water heater piping — reduces retrofit labor and cost

performance_evidence.temperature_rise: Excellent — 11.1 GPM competitive with Rinnai and Navien
performance_evidence.recirculation: Compatible with external recirculation. No built-in pump.
performance_evidence.smart_connectivity: Basic diagnostics. Less advanced than Navien NaviLink or Rinnai Control-R.
performance_evidence.retrofit_advantage: Top-mount connections are a genuine installation cost reducer — plumber consensus confirms this saves 1-2 hours of labor on retrofit.

heat_exchanger_warranty.conditions: 25-year residential limited warranty on heat exchanger — BEST in class. 15yr with recirculation (aquastat). NO conditional drops to 5yr like Navien.

parts_availability.description: Noritz parts available through noritzparts.com and authorized distributors. US parts network thinner than Rinnai's due to smaller market share.

service_network.description: Noritz has US service presence but smaller than Rinnai and Navien. Fewer installers are Noritz-certified. This is a real-world service gap.

common_failure_modes.primary: Scale buildup on HX (universal tankless issue)
common_failure_modes.secondary: High-temp environment cycling issues (reported in attic installations)

safety_evidence.venting: Indoor/outdoor capable. PVC venting for condensing.

platform_disclosure.corporate: Noritz Corporation is a dedicated water heating company. Publicly traded in Japan. No US sub-brands or rebadging.
